bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'STK04_RUNTIME_CONTAINERS\n'
docker ps --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Status}}' | grep -Ei 'gaybbs|create|videobot|video-bot|postgres' | head -n 20 || true
p="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])postgres([-_]|$)' | head -n 1)"
test -n "$p" || { echo STK04_DB_UNAVAILABLE; exit 72; }
printf 'STK04_STICKER_TOPIC_LEDGER\n'
docker exec "$p" sh -c 'psql -At -F "|" -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d gaybbs -c "SELECT topic_id,board_key,purpose,chat_id,message_thread_id,title,enabled FROM posting_topics WHERE message_thread_id=4291 AND chat_id=-1002373696859"'
printf 'STK04_STICKER_TOPIC_DELIVERIES\n'
docker exec "$p" sh -c 'psql -At -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d gaybbs -c "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posting_deliveries WHERE posting_topic_id=112"'
printf 'STK04_TOPIC_PURPOSE_CHECK\n'
docker exec "$p" sh -c 'psql -At -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d gaybbs -c "SELECT pg_get_constraintdef(oid) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid=\x27posting_topics\x27::regclass AND conname=\x27posting_topics_purpose_check\x27"' || true
printf 'STK04_USERBOT_SERVICE\n'
systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'STK04_OWNER_IPC_CLIENT_PATHS\n'
find scripts artifacts/bot/scripts -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -iname '*userbot*ipc*' -o -iname '*userbot*client*' \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -n 12 || true
echo STK04_RUNTIME_AUDIT_DONE
